## Why

Later notes from the S95 relay (run-20261026-172757-ae20, landed 269c391). Owner decisions 2026-10-26 (session a2bf7e0e, interactive questions):
- Stale rows from before S95 (worktree and branch gone, never marked cleaned; the owner's S78 row is one): treat a committed run whose branch is gone and whose Commit.SHA is in HEAD as cleaned, so it leaves Ready and is pruned. Today `c` refuses it with "cleanup needs a committed, merged run".
- The Ready detail line (`internal/tui/overview.go:1413`) and the c confirm (`internal/tui/model.go:1037-1040`, :1076-1077) always name `git worktree remove`, which the daemon skips when the worktree is gone (`internal/daemon/landed.go:162-167`). The daemon sends a *proposed* worktree-gone flag on the snapshot row, and the detail and confirm show only the steps that will run (adj 152 git.cleanup-key: the confirm shows the commands).
Other notes:
- The cleanup status line echoes commands that never ran and a doubled error code ("...: bad_params: bad params: this run is already cleaned up"; model.go:360, handlers.go:44). It predates S95 and affects every daemon refusal.
- After a successful cleanup, say "cleaned up s119" instead of "<command>: done" under the next row.
- build_test.go:56 sets GitBin without the runs lock.
- A cleanup can finish while a merge pass is in flight; the pass then writes a stale merged value for a cleaned run (hidden in the TUI).
- After an external `slicer land` and before `c`, the row still offers the `slicer land` and `slicer render` copy lines; drop them once slicer reports the item landed.
- A landing fix round after the ledger run ended: begin a new relay run or skip relay-run steps (run_ended).
